mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 5-year average signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows, which compresses forward discounting and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 7.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand across sectors, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both rise from their previous month's levels
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST show upward momentum from their previous month's levels.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate below its current level signals potential policy easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS decreases from current level during a tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above its 5-year average reflects robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO is above its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals upward pressure on interest rates, reducing corporate profits and consumer spending, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate investment, which amplifies equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases from their previous month's levels
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS and UNRATE show opposing trends from their previous month's levels.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery phase (e.g., after a recession), a rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average signals renewed economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises above its 4-quarter moving average
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 rises above its 4-quarter moving average in a post-shock recovery regime.
